column3: “Therefore I also said” renders “And also I say”; NASB adds “thorns” to the Hebrew “sides.”
“at the age of one hundred and ten” renders “a son of a hundred and ten years.”
“played the harlot” renders “acted as prostitutes”; “they did not do as their fathers” renders “they did not do so.”
“was moved to pity” renders “had compassion”; “afflicted” renders “oppressed.”
